entries.final_answer: forward-only: emit newly-written RetrospectiveCaptured events with a repository-relative record_path. No historical backfill. Rationale: issue #5868 asks only that the recorded path be repository-relative; the single existing leak was hand-scrubbed on #5856. A cross-repo backfill of already-committed append-only logs is a distinct, larger concern (append-only logs are immutable history) and is out of scope — notable as a possible follow-up only if a leak scan later finds more occurrences.
entries.question: Should the fix also backfill/migrate absolute record_path values already committed to existing status.events.jsonl logs, or only make newly-emitted events repository-relative?
